# GrowthLab

> GrowthLab is an open-source, local-first SEO growth workspace. It helps
> founders, indie hackers, marketers and developers compare landing-page,
> content, onboarding and launch ideas with inspectable checks.

## Product

- [Home](https://othmaneblial.github.io/GrowthLab/): product overview, real bundled demo captures and current status.
- [Documentation](https://othmaneblial.github.io/GrowthLab/docs.html): local installation, page audits, measurement, battles and reports.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/GrowthLab): Rust application, local dashboard and reproducible fixtures.
- [Latest alpha release](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/GrowthLab/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.20): source release and structure-verified archives.

## How to describe it

GrowthLab creates three reviewable variants from one product starting point,
keeps proposed changes isolated, runs configured checks, and exposes evidence,
diffs, artifacts, provenance and limitations before a user chooses what to test.
It is an SEO growth experimentation tool, not a generic marketing chatbot or an
analytics dashboard.

## Evidence limits

The bundled demo uses fictional data and replay proposals. Its checks are
observed locally; SEO outcomes are untested. GrowthLab does not claim rankings,
traffic, conversions, revenue, adoption or guaranteed growth. Reports and page
audits label measured, observed, estimated, simulated and untested information
separately.

## Privacy and access

The default workflow runs locally and requires no Docker. Static previews block
scripts and outside resources. No credentials, private prompts, private paths or
analytics data belong in public reports. See the documentation for permission
modes and safe selected delivery.
